rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone or something cures an illness or heals a wound.

example.english: The doctor helped heal my leg at last.
example.traditional: 醫生終於醫好咗我隻腳。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 zung1 jyu1 ji1 hou2 zo2 ngo5 zek3 goek3

rows.note: Use this when a person, injury, or illness gets better again on its own or after treatment.

example.english: My leg began to heal after a few days of rest.
example.traditional: 我隻腳休息咗幾日就好返喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 jau1 sik1 zo2 gei2 jat6 zau6 hou2 faan1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when people reconcile and become friendly again after a disagreement.

example.english: They finally managed to heal their rift after arguing.
example.traditional: 佢哋鬧交之後終於和好喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 naau6 gaau1 zi1 hau6 zung1 jyu1 wo4 hou2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for repairing a damaged relationship or mending a breach rather than for people simply making up.

example.english: To heal this relationship, everyone has to be more honest.
example.traditional: 要修補呢段關係，大家都要坦白啲。
example.jyutping: jiu3 sau1 bou2 ni1 dyun6 gwaan1 hai6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu3 taan2 baak6 di1
